newsitem.title: USA: OrthoLogic stock falls on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: OrthoLogic stock falls on profit warning.

text.p: The stock of OrthoLogic Corp. tumbled in heavy trading Wednesday, a day after the maker of advanced orthopaedic devices warned of disappointing quarterly earnings.
The stock plunged $4.375 to $7 on Nasdaq, where it was the most active issue shortly before midday.
Hambrecht & Quist downgraded Orthologic's stock to hold and lowered its earnings estimates.

Late Tuesday, OrthoLogic said it expects earnings per share of 2 cents to 4 cents in the third quarter, sharply below analysts' forecasts of 8 cents. It expects revenues of $10.4 to $10.8 million for the period.
In the 1995 third quarter, the company reported a net loss of $99.9 million, or 1 cent a share, on revenues of $4.05 million.

The Phoenix, Ariz.-based company attributed its weak outlook to an unexpectedly small rise in sales after its recent conversion to a direct sales force from an independent dealer network, and to the costs related to the transition.
Orthologic said it expects to report third-quarter results on Oct. 22.
